description: Font enumeration: a mandatory platform core set plus independent installed-software bundles. enumeration_allowlist values from the core and every included pack are unioned and de-duplicated in file order. Removal is always servable; addition needs the font files, so a pack is only offered when its files are present on the host or provisioned into the profile, and anything missing is reported as a limitation.
label: font_packs

options.note: Mandatory core set: the families the claimed platform cannot be without. Enumeration is subtractive and always servable, but a missing core family is the defensible detection (docs/METHODOLOGY.md), so a host that cannot serve one is reported as a limitation rather than silently narrowed. Measured fonts.detected set on the Apple M4 Max reference host. It includes Menlo, Monaco, Zapfino, PingFang SC and Helvetica Neue, the families a machine claiming macOS cannot lack.

Installed-software bundle. A pack is all-or-nothing: installed fonts arrive together, and a handful of individually drawn families is synthesis and a tell (docs/FINGERPRINTS.md section 3). Microsoft Office for Mac font set. Calibri, Cambria and Consolas are Office-supplied on macOS and platform-core on Windows, which is why the pack contents differ per platform. AUTHORED, NOT MEASURED: the family list is the bundle's published contents, and the weight is an authored prevalence.

Installed-software bundle. A pack is all-or-nothing: installed fonts arrive together, and a handful of individually drawn families is synthesis and a tell (docs/FINGERPRINTS.md section 3).
